news.title: Singer Chinmayi Faces Online Heat Over Ramayana Track
news.summary: Playback singer Chinmayi Sripada has drawn heavy criticism on social media after announcing that she sang the Tamil version of the Jai Jai Ram track for the upcoming Ramayana film. Trolls and critics resurfaced her past remarks criticizing Lord Rama's treatment of Sita, sparking an intense online debate about her involvement in the project. The multi-part epic is directed by Nitesh Tiwari and features Ranbir Kapoor and Sai Pallavi in lead roles.

news.title: Raghav Juyal Pens Heartfelt Note for Nani After The Paradise
news.summary: Actor Raghav Juyal shared an emotional tribute to Nani following their collaboration on the action drama The Paradise. Calling Nani his safe place and mentor, Raghav expressed deep gratitude for the guidance and support he received during the film's production. The gritty actioner, directed by Srikanth Odela, features an ensemble cast including Mohan Babu and Kayadu Lohar.

news.title: KTR Heading to Theatres to Catch Nani's The Paradise
news.summary: BRS Working President KT Rama Rao announced on social media that he will visit a cinema hall after many years to watch Nani's latest movie, The Paradise. KTR expressed admiration for both Nani and director Srikanth Odela ahead of his screening. The film has drawn additional political attention due to Priyadarshi portraying an MLA character whose background shares similarities with KCR.

news.title: Is Chiranjeevi Silent on Vishwambhara Due to Quality Concerns?
news.summary: Megastar Chiranjeevi's continued silence regarding his socio-fantasy project Vishwambhara has sparked speculation among fans and observers. While the actor actively promotes his other venture Kaaka directed by Bobby, he has avoided discussing his role or updates on Mallidi Vasishta's directorial. Fans have grown concerned that the team's quiet approach stems from a lack of confidence following earlier criticism of the teaser's visual effects.

news.title: Vicky Kaushal Sports a Daring Look in Sanjay Leela Bhansali's Upcoming Project
news.summary: The makers of the multi-starrer Love And War have revealed the first-look poster featuring Vicky Kaushal in an edgy avatar. Sporting a confident expression while lighting a cigar, the actor adds a distinct swagger to the promotional campaign. Directed by Sanjay Leela Bhansali, the venture also stars Ranbir Kapoor and Alia Bhatt ahead of its scheduled theatrical release in January 2027.

news.title: Hombale Films Takes Over Southern Theatrical Distribution for Hit Venture
news.summary: Following a successful theatrical run spanning multiple weeks, the small-budget acclaimed feature Hanuman Ansh has found a new distribution partner. Prominent Kannada banner Hombale Films has secured the entire South Indian theatrical rights for the movie. Plans are underway to bring the project to audiences in Telugu, Tamil, Kannada, and Malayalam soon.

news.title: Junior NTR Reportedly Set as Chief Guest for Upcoming Fahadh Faasil Movie Event
news.summary: The promotional events for the upcoming film Don't Trouble The Trouble, starring Fahadh Faasil, are ramping up ahead of its early October release. Word has emerged that actor Young Tiger NTR will attend the pre-release celebration as the main guest. Directed by Shashank Yeleti, the movie is presented by SS Rajamouli and backed by Arka Media.

news.title: Chiranjeevi Adds Humor to Trolls at Sigma Pre-Release Event
news.summary: Megastar Chiranjeevi brought his trademark wit to the Hyderabad pre-release event of the upcoming film Sigma. He playfully addressed social media rumors about blocking others' growth by teasing actress Faria Abdullah over missing a dance opportunity with him in Vishwambhara. The action-adventure heist movie, directed by Jason Sanjay, is scheduled to hit theaters on October 2, 2026.

news.title: Chiranjeevi Confirms Sankranti 2027 Release for Kaaka
news.summary: Megastar Chiranjeevi has provided a fresh progress report on his upcoming film Kaaka, confirming its theatrical release for Sankranti on January 13, 2027. He shared that the entire first half and about 30 percent of the second half have already been wrapped up. Meanwhile, the actor chose not to comment on the release timeline of his other project, Vishwambhara.

news.title: Vicky Kaushal Reveals Rugged Retro Look for Sanjay Leela Bhansali's Love & War
news.summary: Vicky Kaushal has shared his striking first-look poster for Sanjay Leela Bhansali's upcoming directorial Love & War. Sporting facial wounds and lighting a vintage cigarette, his intense wartime character comes with the tagline 'Nazre milengi, lekin hatengi nahin!' The multi-starrer period drama, also featuring Ranbir Kapoor and Alia Bhatt, is slated for a worldwide release on January 21, 2027.

news.title: Nani's The Paradise Crosses 100 Crore Mark in Record Two Days
news.summary: Nani's period action drama The Paradise has stormed the box office by grossing over 114 crores globally within just two days of release. Directed by Srikanth Odela, the film has set a new personal record for the actor as his fastest entry into the 100-crore club. Backed by producer Sudhakar Cherukuri, the movie is continuing its strong performance across domestic and overseas markets.

news.title: Megastar Chiranjeevi's Kaaka Speeds Through Production
news.summary: Megastar Chiranjeevi is wrapping up his upcoming film Kaaka at a remarkably fast pace under the direction of Bobby Kolli. The team has already finished the complete first half alongside nearly 30 percent of the second half, with composer S Thaman actively working on the background score. The project remains on track for a theatrical release during Sankranti 2027.

news.title: Taapsee Pannu Recalls Being Dropped Due to Lead Actor's Spouse
news.summary: Actress Taapsee Pannu shared one of the most unusual experiences of her career where she was replaced in a film after her dates had already been locked. She was informed that the lead actor's wife disliked her, leading to her removal from the project. Taapsee noted that such sudden changes can heavily disrupt an actor's schedule and block them from other opportunities.

news.title: Mythri Film Distributors Face High-Stakes Month in Nizam
news.summary: Mythri Film Distributors are navigating a critical four-week stretch in the Nizam region as they heavily invest in multiple high-profile releases. Despite taking a gamble on expensive distribution rights and facing early box office tests with titles like The Paradise, the firm is relying on its slate of upcoming biggies. Fortunately, partnership arrangements help distribute the financial risk across these ventures.

news.title: The Paradise Day Two Box Office Stability Driven by Telangana
news.summary: Natural Star Nani's starrer The Paradise brought in a gross of around Rs. 19 crores on its second day, driven largely by a solid performance in Telangana. While overseas territories and Andhra Pradesh experienced notable declines, the strong turnout in Nizam prevented a steeper overall drop. The team now looks to the weekend collections to help recover lost ground in other regions.

news.title: Venkatesh and Trivikram's Family Drama Shifts Arrival Date
news.summary: The Venkatesh and Trivikram family entertainer Aadarsha Kutumbam has shifted its theatrical release from October 2 to October 9. Alongside this schedule change, the promotional track featuring the lead cast is set to premiere tomorrow. The big-ticket production also features Nara Rohith, Pujita Ponnada, and other notable actors under Haarika & Hassine Creations.

news.title: Nani Addresses The Paradise Backlash Amid Solid Box Office Figures
news.summary: Despite facing mixed feedback and intense online trolling, Nani's starrer The Paradise pulled off a massive opening day by collecting over ₹75 crore. The lead actor, director Srikanth Odela, and other core team members are addressing the media to discuss the criticism directly. The upcoming weekend remains critical for the film's journey toward the ₹100 crore milestone.

news.title: Preity Mukhundhan Bags Lead Role Alongside Dhanush in D56
news.summary: Actress Preity Mukhundhan, who recently appeared in Lubber Pandhu and Kannappa, has officially joined the cast of Dhanush's 56th film, D56. Helmed by director Tamizharasan Pachamuthu, the project held its traditional pooja ceremony to mark the start of production. The film features a notable supporting cast including SJ Suryah and Vadivelu.

news.title: The Paradise Overseas Earnings Experience Steep Slump on Second Day
news.summary: Nani's latest international release, The Paradise, registered a record-breaking start by grossing $2.3 million on its opening day overseas. However, negative word-of-mouth led to a steep decline on day two, adding only $250K to bring the two-day total to $2.55 million. The abrupt drop points toward a challenging theatrical run in overseas markets.

news.title: Keerthy Suresh Starrer Dorothy Sparks Debate Over Queer Theme
news.summary: Keerthy Suresh traveled to the Toronto International Film Festival to promote her Tamil project Dorothy, directed by Karthik Subbaraj. Following its theatrical rollout, the movie generated polarized responses and online trolling regarding its second-half queer narrative and climax. While certain viewers and critics appreciated the feature, others voiced strong objections to its storyline.

news.title: Megastar Chiranjeevi Surprises Fans With Self-Deprecating Humor at Sigma Event
news.summary: Megastar Chiranjeevi addressed online trolling and the persistent social media narrative targeting him during the pre-release event of the movie Sigma. In a surprising move, the veteran actor playfully teased leading lady Faria Abdullah by joking about restricting her growth, effectively shutting down online critics with humor. Chiranjeevi is currently occupied with his upcoming venture Kaaka, helmed by director Bobby.

news.title: Chiranjeevi Compares Sundeep Kishan's Experimental Choices to His Early Career
news.summary: Megastar Chiranjeevi attended the Sigma pre-release gathering as chief guest, praising lead actor Sundeep Kishan for consistently picking unique scripts. Directed by Jason Sanjay and backed by Lyca Productions, the heist action drama is scheduled to hit screens on October 2nd through Mythri Distributions. During the celebrations, Chiranjeevi drew parallels between Kishan's career trajectory and the fierce independence of his own early acting days.

news.title: Nani Starrer The Paradise Holds Ground on Day Two
news.summary: Despite facing negative talk upon release, actor Nani's latest movie The Paradise managed to avoid a major box office drop on its second day. Trade figures indicate that the project brought in over Rs. 20 crores in gross collections globally on a regular working day. Strong traction in the Nizam sector helped sustain momentum ahead of the weekend box office run in the Telugu states.

news.title: Vijay Deverakonda Appears as a Fierce Fighter in Fresh Promotional Poster for Ranabaali
news.summary: The production team behind the pan-India historical drama Ranabaali has released a brand new poster featuring lead actor Vijay Deverakonda in a fierce warrior avatar. Directed by Rahul Sankrityan and co-starring Rashmika Mandanna, the film is scheduled to hit global cinemas on October 16, 2026, for Vijayadashami. Set in the 19th century under British rule, the project is inspired by true historical events from 1854 to 1878.
